title: Chapter 8 Summary: The Sermon at Benares
body: The story of Kisa Gotami who loses her son and asks Buddha for a medicine to bring him back to life. Buddha sends her to get mustard seeds from a house where no one has died. This makes her realise the universality of death and grief.
body_hi: किसा गोतमी की कहानी जो अपने पुत्र को खो देती है और बुद्ध से उसे जीवित करने की दवा मांगती है।
